messages:
Sam: Quick sync: we collected 4 pilot follow-ups today. need a compact handoff to product by 9am PT tomorrow. focus: onboarding blockers, clear feature asks, any explicit renewal risk notes.
Priya: I'll consolidate notes. prefer bullet rows in-thread first, then I'll drop a CSV link. columns: customer | ask | severity(low/med/high) | renewal_risk(yes/no/unclear) | sample_quote | contact | triage(rec) | eta_estimate
Omar: throwing in enablement column too: docs/train/runbook? also flag if trainer session needed.
Sam: yes please. one-line per customer. product wants scannable list; add impact score 1-5 if possible.
Priya: raw call snippets pasted, cleaning next:
- GreenPath: onboarding stuck at "verify org" step; rep spent 12 mins troubleshooting, "couldn't finish the trial" -> severity: high, renewal_risk: yes
- Trailhead: customer confused by token usage across routes; finance asked for per-route export -> severity: med, renewal_risk: unclear
- Northbridge: web UI shows stale model version in dropdown after deploy -> severity: med, renewal_risk: mentioned
- Quanta: batch upload fails silently when CSV contains empty header row, requires manual cleanup -> severity: low, renewal_risk: no
elaine: note on Trailhead: docs-first. small playbook + billing-export sample should mitigate. estimate 2 days for docs + cs-notes.
Omar: GreenPath is demo-blocker. we should flag engineering immediately; I'll upload the repro log and endpoint `/v1/orgs/verify` to the ticket.
triage-bot: Reminder: product triage slot tomorrow 10am PT. Add consolidated rows to backlog as pre-read.
Priya: CSV uploaded: <internal-drive/link>  4 rows with quotes and call timestamps. added impact scores: GreenPath=5, Trailhead=3, Northbridge=3, Quanta=1.
Sam: great. action items: Omar files eng ticket for GreenPath with logs, elaine drafts Trailhead playbook, Priya posts the CSV link to product and pins this thread for updates.
Omar: filed ENG-9124: "verify-org flow timeout" and attached logs. marked P0.
elaine: draft ready for Trailhead; will share link in drive and run a 30-min CS workshop next week.
Priya: pushed to product backlog and requested an LOE estimate. noted which items are likely Q2 renewal-impacting.
Sam: thanks. please append any further pilot notes here with call_ts + recording link. closing loop after product triage. :white_check_mark:
